item.title: Ghalibaf: US ‘arsenal’ of interventions, Treasury falsehoods will fail to curb oil prices
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf has mocked Washington’s efforts to curb rising oil prices, and said the US measures, including market interventions and the release of strategic reserves, have failed to stop the surge in crude prices.

item.title: IRGC destroys US unmanned vessel in Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Cambodian PM condemns aggression against Iran; stresses start of a new phase in bilateral cooperation
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — In a meeting with the ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Prime Minister of Cambodia condemned the recent US-Israeli aggression against Iran and the violation of international principles and values; and described the arrival of the new Iranian ambassador in Phnom Penh as the start of a significant new phase in cooperation between the two nations while stressing the expansion of bilateral relations.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86260612/Cambodian-PM-condemns-aggression-against-Iran-stresses-start

Tehran, IRNA — In a meeting with the ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Prime Minister of Cambodia condemned the recent US-Israeli aggression against Iran and the violation of international principles and values; and described the arrival of the new Iranian ambassador in Phnom Penh as the start of a significant new phase in cooperation between the two nations while stressing the expansion of bilateral relations.

item.title: Iran condemns US sanctions on 27 Iranian airlines as ‘economic terrorism’
item.description: New York, IRNA — The Islamic Republic has condemned new US sanctions targeting 27 Iranian airlines and aviation-related entities, describing the measures as “economic terrorism” and “ collective punishment” that threaten civilian aviation safety and restrict the movement of millions of people.

item.title: Iran rejects US claims, says Ansarallah makes its own decisions
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran has rejected US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s allegations of Iranian interference in Yemen, stressing that the Ansarallah movement is an independent Yemeni actor that makes its own decisions and does not operate as a proxy for any country.

item.title: Iran strongly rejects false claims contained in the statement issued at Arab League FM meeting
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — In a statement, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran rejected and condemned all the false claims and baseless accusations leveled against Iran in the final communiqué of the 166th session of the Arab League Council of Foreign Ministers.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86260039/Iran-strongly-rejects-false-claims-contained-in-the-statement

Tehran, IRNA — In a statement, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran rejected and condemned all the false claims and baseless accusations leveled against Iran in the final communiqué of the 166th session of the Arab League Council of Foreign Ministers.
